title: Restrict Schematron abstract rule extension to its pattern
api_or_output: Unchanged public/frozen API; same-pattern abstract-rule reference checking before schema publication

Preserve valid same-pattern chains, abstract-pattern instantiation and external include/body provenance.

Record bounded independent review, actual integrated checks and relevant allocation evidence without changing frozen interfaces or earlier evidence. Unblock corpus only after verified repair.
